# User Guide

## Sales Module
- Navigate to Sales → Create Invoice
- Select customer
- Add products & quantities
- Apply discounts/taxes
- Save → system generates invoice ID & PDF

## Inventory Module
- Navigate to Inventory → Adjust Stock
- Choose product
- Enter qty + adjustment type (IN / OUT / TRANSFER)
- Save → system updates stock balance

## HR Module
- Navigate to HR → Leave Request
- Choose leave type & date range
- Submit request
- Wait for supervisor approval
